scenario.title: 跟朋友說不舒服、到診所描述症狀
scenario.context: 生病時最需要講清楚，卻最容易卡住：頭痛、喉嚨痛、拉肚子、全身無力。英文描述症狀有很固定的句型，學會 have a + 名詞和 My ___ hurts，看醫生就不慌。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Hey, are we still on for dinner tonight?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ugh, I'm so sorry. I think I'm coming down with something.
lines.zh: 唉，真的很抱歉，我好像快生病了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I have a sore throat and a bit of a fever. I've felt off all day.
lines.zh: 喉嚨痛，還有點發燒。整天都怪怪的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: You've been working way too much. You're probably run-down.
lines.zh: 你最近工作太多了，大概是累垮了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Probably. Can we do next week instead?
lines.zh: 應該是。我們改下週好嗎？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Of course. Get some rest and drink lots of water!

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: So, what seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I have a bad cough and a runny nose. And my whole body aches.
lines.zh: 我咳得很嚴重、流鼻水，全身痠痛。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: How long have you had these symptoms?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: About three days. The cough started first.
lines.zh: 大概三天。一開始是咳嗽。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I had a slight fever last night, around 38.
lines.zh: 昨晚有點發燒，大概 38 度。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I felt a little sick to my stomach this morning, but I didn't throw up.
lines.zh: 今天早上有點反胃，但沒有吐。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.en: OK. It looks like a viral infection. I'll give you something for the cough.
lines.zh: 好。看起來是病毒感染，我開止咳的藥給你。

patterns.en: I have a headache / a sore throat / a fever.
I have a runny nose / a stuffy nose.
I feel sick to my stomach.
patterns.note: 美式 I feel sick 常常就是指想吐
口語也說 I have an upset stomach（比較委婉）

patterns.en: I think I'm coming down with something.
How long have you had it?

patterns.note: 比 Get well soon 更口語

chinglish.right: I have a headache. / My head hurts.
chinglish.why: pain 是名詞，不能當形容詞用。中文「我頭很痛」的結構直翻就會出錯，英文要用 have a headache 或 My head hurts。

chinglish.right: I caught a cold. / I have a cold.
chinglish.why: 感冒是已經發生的事，要用過去式 caught，或描述現在狀態 I have a cold。

chinglish.right: I don't feel well. / I'm not feeling well.
chinglish.why: uncomfortable 在英文裡多指「不自在、尷尬」或身體姿勢不舒服，生病說 I don't feel well 比較準確。
流感習慣說 the flu；感冒則是 a cold。這是固定用法。

grammar.title: 症狀表達：have a + 名詞
grammar.oneLiner: 英文描述症狀多半是「擁有」一個病痛名詞：I have a headache，而不是「我的頭很痛苦」。
whenToUse: have a + 症狀名詞：a headache, a stomachache, a sore throat, a fever, a cough, a cold, a runny nose。
身體部位 + hurt(s)：My back hurts. / My eyes hurt.
feel + 形容詞：I feel dizzy / tired / sick / weak.
特例：the flu（流感）用 the；diarrhea（腹瀉）不可數，不加 a。
已經好幾天了：I've had a cough for three days.（現在完成式，第 12、21 單元會詳細講）
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文描述症狀多是「部位 + 痛」：頭痛、胃痛、喉嚨痛，動詞是「痛」。台灣人會很自然地想找一個對應「痛」的形容詞，結果造出 My head is pain。英文的思路是：你「擁有」一個叫 headache 的東西，或是某個部位「在痛」（hurts）。

examples.note: pain 是名詞，改用 have a headache。
hurt 在這裡是動詞「痛」，不是被動。
喉嚨痛有固定說法：sore throat。

examples.correct: I've had a fever since last night.
examples.note: 從某時開始持續的症狀用現在完成式。

examples.correct: I feel dizzy when I stand up.
examples.incorrect: I am dizzy feeling when I stand up.

quiz.question: I have a ___ throat. It hurts when I swallow.
My knee ___ when I walk up stairs.
I can't come to work. I have ___ flu.
I ___ dizzy. I think I need to sit down.

slang.usage: 說不出哪裡不舒服，但就是狀況不好。也可以說 I feel a bit off today.

risk.note: 跟同事說也很自然，請假時可以用來開頭。

examples.en: I've felt a bit off since lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後我就覺得怪怪的。

examples.en: Something's off. I think I'm getting sick.
examples.zh: 有點不對勁，我好像要生病了。

slang.usage: 長期疲勞、壓力大導致身體變差，容易生病的狀態。

risk.note: 也可以形容建築物「破舊」（a run-down building），看語境判斷。

examples.en: I've been feeling run-down since the deadline.
examples.zh: 趕完截稿之後我就一直很虛。

examples.en: You look run-down. Take a day off.
examples.zh: 你看起來很累，請一天假吧。

slang.usage: come down with + 病名，常用在感冒、流感剛開始時。I think I'm coming down with something.

risk.note: 中性，跟主管請假也能用。

examples.en: Half the office came down with the flu last week.
examples.zh: 上週辦公室有一半的人得了流感。

examples.en: I think I'm coming down with a cold.

slang.usage: throw up / vomit 的粗俗口語版，朋友間說。

risk.note: 很直白，有點噁心的畫面感。看醫生說 vomit，跟同事說 throw up。

examples.en: That roller coaster almost made me puke.
examples.zh: 那個雲霄飛車差點讓我吐出來。

examples.en: He drank too much and puked in the taxi.
examples.zh: 他喝太多，在計程車上吐了。

review.question: Which sentence is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 7 單元：天氣用虛主詞 It。

review.question: These shoes are a ___ too tight. Do you have a bigger size?
review.explanation: 複習第 6 單元：a little too… = 有點太…

review.question: I ___ a cold last week, but I'm fine now.
I think I'm coming ___ with something. My throat feels weird.
review.explanation: come down with = 開始生病。
